fullPassage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into a completely different creature. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.

③ fight off every passing predator: 모든 포식자와 싸우기 — 본문에 없음
④ sleep deeply during the daytime: 낮에 깊이 자기 — 밤에 사냥하는 것과 어긋남
det.tip: best defence + hunt at night → stay hidden(숨어 있기)

ch: stay hidden as much as possible

questions.passage: The best defence most species of octopus have is to stay hidden as much as possible and do their own hunting at night. So to find one in full view in the shallows in daylight was a surprise for two Australian underwater photographers. Actually, what they saw at first was a flounder. It was only when they looked again that they saw a medium-sized octopus, with all eight of its arms folded and its two eyes staring upwards to create the illusion. An octopus has a big brain, excellent eyesight and the ability to change colour and pattern, and this one was using these assets to turn itself into __________. Many more of this species have been found since then, and there are now photographs of octopuses that could be said to be transforming into sea snakes. And while they mimic, they hunt — producing the spectacle of, say, a flounder suddenly developing an octopodian arm, sticking it down a hole and grabbing whatever's hiding there.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸 = a completely different creature(완전히 다른 생물)
det.analysis:
① a much larger predator: 훨씬 큰 포식자 — 본문 근거 없음
② a completely different creature: 큰 뇌·시력·색 변화 능력으로 자신을 '완전히 다른 생물'로 바꿈 ←정답 (넙치·바다뱀으로 변신)
③ its original hiding spot: 원래 숨는 곳 — 변신 문맥과 무관
④ a school of small fish: 작은 물고기 떼 — 부적절
det.tip: turn itself into ~ = 자신을 ~로 바꾸다 → 완전히 다른 생물
